englishMetadata.title: Game Mathematics Part 2: Quaternions 2 — Composition, Target Orientation and Vector Rotation
englishMetadata.description:
Once we can store and reverse a rotation, how should we compose two rotations? We separate body and world references, compute the rotation difference to a target and examine the short path. Observation lines on gameplay are distinct from measured world axes. Finally, we rotate and reverse the same vector to understand why multiplication is required on both sides. This is the second of two quaternion lectures.

📚 Game Math PART2 course materials
YamYamWiki · Game Math PART2

https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

40% actual gameplay and60% explanation, narrated without background music.

Chapters
00:00 Overview: composition and vector rotation
00:41 Opposite rotations and the reversal process
02:05 What dot and cross products each tell us
03:30 Application order and multiplication sides
06:31 Relative rotation between two orientations
07:22 Minimum angle from the dot product
11:35 A fraction of the same rotation
12:23 Powers and path choices
13:21 One-sided and two-sided products on the same vector
14:20 Why vector rotation uses both sides
16:31 Code conventions and checks
17:23 Rotate and reverse the worked vector
18:34 What to remember
19:03 Membership thanks and programming coaching
